solutions.title: Check every possible start
solutions.strategy: For each starting index, consume word-sized chunks and compare their counts with the required counts.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are O(n) starts, each can inspect m words of length w.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The seen counter can hold up to the number of words.

solutions.title: Word-length offset sliding window
solutions.strategy: Run a counted sliding window for each word-length offset, shrinking from the left when a word is overused or absent.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each offset scans the string in word-sized steps, substring extraction costs up to word length, and r reported indices are sorted for deterministic ascending output.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Counters store required and current word frequencies.
